mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO reactions(article_id, user_uuid, type) VALUES(#{articleId}, #{userUuid}, #{type})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM reactions WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND user_uuid = #{userUuid} AND type = #{type}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chats(article_id, user_uuid, content) VALUES(#{articleId}, #{userUuid}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT id, article_id, user_uuid, content, create_time FROM chats WHERE article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, from_uuid, to_uuid, message, status, create_time FROM friend_requests WHERE from_uuid = #{fromUuid} AND to_uuid = #{toUuid} AND status = 'pending' LIMIT 1
SELECT id, from_uuid, to_uuid, message, status, create_time FROM friend_requests WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_requests(from_uuid, to_uuid, message, status) VALUES(#{fromUuid}, #{toUuid}, #{message}, 'pending')
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_requests SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND to_uuid = #{toUuid} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO friends(user_uuid, friend_uuid) VALUES(#{userUuid}, #{friendUuid})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM friends WHERE (user_uuid = #{userUuid} AND friend_uuid = #{friendUuid}) OR (user_uuid = #{friendUuid} AND friend_uuid = #{userUuid})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM friends WHERE user_uuid = #{userUuid} AND friend_uuid = #{friendUuid}

SELECT u.uuid, u.username, u.avatar, u.introduction, f.create_time AS friend_since FROM friends f JOIN `user` u ON u.uuid = f.friend_uuid AND u.is_deleted =0 WHERE f.user_uuid = #{userUuid} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
SELECT id, from_uuid, to_uuid, message, status, create_time FROM friend_requests WHERE to_uuid = #{toUuid} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY create_time DESC
